newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air France hikes India, TPE, BUE rates J.
newsitem.headline: Air France hikes India, TPE, BUE rates J.

text.p: Air France will raise ex-Germany air cargo rates to India, Taiwan and Argentina from January 10, a Germany cargo department statement said.
The increased rates would apply to flights to Delhi, Bombay, Madras, Bangalore, Taipei and Buenos Aires, a circular to German freight forwarders said.
Air France Cargo Germany director Helmut Scherret told Reuter he did not wish to release any details about the rates rises.
Air France sources noted, however, that German market rates to India had fallen dramatically in recent months and needed to be corrected.
Both Lufthansa Cargo AG and KLM Royal Dutch Airlines have already announced they will raise rates to India early next year. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
